title: Rabbi Acha bar Chisda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael, under “Amoraim,” cites him at Bava Batra 36b. Hyman says this is mistaken: Rav Chisda there says, “It is Rabbi Acha's view,” referring to Rabbi Acha the Tanna.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Bava Batra 36b explicitly has Rav Chisda identifying Rabbi Acha’s opinion in a baraita. Hyman argues that this attribution was wrongly read as a patronymic.

The quotation supports a distinction between an attribution of an opinion and a patronymic. Hyman’s criticism of Otzar Yisrael and identification of Rabbi Acha as the Tanna remain his argument; Otzar Yisrael itself has not been newly collated here.
